answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable bond on a public ledge of stake before earning, with payouts vesting over a long horizon. Every epoch it must also produce a fresh, jury-graded generation. A sybil farm therefore pays one bond plus one real inference per fake identity per epoch, while vesting delays any loot; proven duplicates lose their bonds. Like stars counted in a nebula, fakes stop being free duplicates and become costly, visible points that must each be fed.
